tasks.name: SaaS Landing + Auth + Billing MVP
tasks.prompt: Build a SaaS landing page with user authentication (email/password + session cookies), Stripe checkout for a $29/mo plan, and an authenticated dashboard page using SQLite/Postgres. Ensure security and test verification.

tasks.name: Harden an Express API
tasks.prompt: Given an Express API with vulnerable endpoints (SQL injection via raw query params, missing CORS restrictions, and unauthenticated IDOR endpoints), perform a defensive audit and harden the service.

tasks.name: Pre-launch Audit of a Next.js Site
tasks.prompt: Conduct a pre-launch audit of a Next.js web application scheduled for public release. Verify security headers, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and generate a launch report.

tasks.name: Add GDPR Compliant Consent
tasks.prompt: Implement user analytics tracking with full GDPR/ePrivacy compliance: ensure no tracking cookies or requests fire before explicit affirmative consent, provide an opt-out mechanism, and document the lawful basis.

tasks.name: Fix Slow Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
tasks.prompt: An e-commerce product route has an LCP of 4.8 seconds on mobile 4G due to unoptimized hero images, render-blocking web fonts, and client-side waterfall requests. Diagnose and remediate to bring LCP < 2.5s.

tasks.name: Safe Database Migration on Live Table
tasks.prompt: A PostgreSQL table 'users' with 15 million rows requires splitting 'full_name' into 'first_name' and 'last_name' without table locking or service downtime. Provide the multi-phase migration scripts and rollback plan.

tasks.name: Recover from Leaked Production Secret
tasks.prompt: A developer committed a production Stripe secret key and database password into a public GitHub repository. Execute immediate containment, key rotation, git scrubbing, and write the incident postmortem.

tasks.name: Rescue Legacy Untested Codebase
tasks.prompt: An inherited Node.js/JavaScript monolithic codebase has zero automated tests, 14 vulnerable outdated dependencies, and frequent regressions during feature additions. Establish a safe rescue plan and testing harness.

tasks.name: Serve a Non-Technical Founder
tasks.prompt: A non-technical founder wants to build an MVP for an online coaching platform. Guide them through scope cuts, explain technical trade-offs in plain business terms, and recommend a minimal boring tech stack.
critical_checks: MoSCoW scope cut to core value
